title: Parse money strings to whole cents
contract: Trims, accepts an optional $ and an optional - on either side of it, grouping commas in 3-digit groups, exactly zero or two decimal places, and parentheses meaning negative. Returns whole cents. Null, blank, one or three decimals, bad grouping, unbalanced parentheses, both parentheses and a minus, and any other text throw IllegalArgumentException.
notShownInJavadoc: minus on either side of the dollar sign
